Job Title: ML Engineer - GenAI
Experience: 3-6 years
Location: Hybrid: Hyderabad or Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Python
- Large Language Models

Good to have:
- Prompt Engineering
- Vector Databases

Responsibilities:
- Join a fast-growing AI team at NovaByte Labs, a startup building generative AI products for enterprise knowledge discovery and automation.
- Design, develop and productionize components of GenAI services using Python and state-of-the-art Large Language Models.
- Implement model fine-tuning, evaluation pipelines, and monitoring to ensure robust performance and cost-efficiency in production.
- Collaborate with product managers and engineers to integrate LLM-powered features into web and backend applications.
- Build and maintain inference services, optimize latency and throughput, and work on model serving and scaling strategies.
- Contribute to data engineering tasks for preparing training and retrieval datasets, and implement validation and augmentation workflows.
- Participate in code reviews, architect decisions, and mentor junior engineers on best practices for model development and deployment.
- Optionally apply Prompt Engineering techniques and integrate Vector Databases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions where applicable.
